newsitem.title: GERMANY: German cash cocoa buyers seek lower prices.
newsitem.headline: German cash cocoa buyers seek lower prices.

text.p: German cocoa consumers are targeting physical prices some 0.10-0.15 marks per kilo below the price range on offer, traders said.
Third quarter 1997 beans of good West African quality were offered at 2.99 marks cif for the third quarter and fourth quarter beans were at 3.04 marks.
The offers were little changed from a week ago when futures were lower but sterling, the cocoa currency, was higher versus the mark.

Futures falls by 30 stg or a clear decline from sterling's levels just under 3.00 marks would entice some buyers at medium sized manufacturers, which needed raw materials for the autumn season, the traders said.
But multinational confectionery companies operating here were well covered.
Slow retail sales and a lack of fresh fundamental news also contributed to the sales lull.
The cocoa butter ratio over futures rose one percentage point to 2.48 points for 1997.
Butter prices liquid, ex-works, were at 7.55 marks for the third quarter (7.52 last week) and at 7.68 (7.66) for the fourth.
Sterling was at 2.9915 marks at the daily Frankfurt exchange fixing versus 3.0703 last week.
